title: A helper signal
hook: Predict the interaction and trace one immune step.

knows: The immune system includes cells and signaling molecules.
doesNotKnow: Helper T-cell signals can support activation and proliferation of appropriately stimulated B cells. The diagram omits the required antigen recognition and other interactions.

misconception: The immune response consists of one cell acting alone.
objective: Explain the stated interaction in a simplified immune response.

claims.text: Question, stage and reveal: When a B cell receives the appropriate antigen and helper-T-cell signals, what can those signals help it do? Helper T-cell signals can support activation and proliferation of appropriately stimulated B cells. The diagram omits the required antigen recognition and other interactions.
Icons show one selected interaction rather than all required signals, and are not to scale.
Recall: Which immune cell can helper T-cell signals support during an appropriate antibody response? Helper T-cell signals can support appropriately stimulated B cells.

recall.question: Which immune cell can helper T-cell signals support during an appropriate antibody response?
recall.why: Helper T-cell signals can support appropriately stimulated B cells.
